I told Hollis in a thread on their #central-team message that the site for the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is **Gate 47**.

On Oct 14 Pree first posted Dock 23 in that channel, then corrected it to Gate 47 the same day because they'd read the wrong line. Nobody has posted a different site there since. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so they can see both of Pree's messages themselves.
